newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica nears decisions on assets.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica nears decisions on assets.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp said it is nearing some conclusions in its ongoing study of its businesses to determine which are producing adequate returns.

"We are looking at all businesses and we're reaching some conclusions and are making some decisions," said chief financial officer Mike O'Neill on a conference call following the release of its third quarter results.
He said the bank's recent decision to sell 68 rural branches in Texas and other recent asset sales reflected this ongoing process.
BankAmerica earlier reported third quarter net of $1.75 a share versus $1.72 a share, including a one-time assessment of $82 million for Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF) recapitalization.
The First Call mean estimate for the quarter was $1.83 a share. Some analysts said that the company came in line, if the SAIF assessment is excluded.
But others said the earnings were slightly below expectations, because the SAIF assessment was offset by certain non-recurring gains.
